# Ultra Home Repair

> Ultra Home Repair is an Irvine-based handyman, home repair, and home maintenance company serving Irvine and surrounding Orange County communities. The company specializes in plumbing fixture replacement, tankless water heater maintenance, electrical fixture installation, drywall repair, Realtor pre-listing and post-inspection repair services, and landlord repair and maintenance services.

Ultra Home Repair is known for fast response, clear communication, professional workmanship, and reliable service for homeowners, real estate agents, landlords, and property managers throughout Orange County.

Core service areas include Irvine, Woodbury, Stonegate, Great Park, Orchard Hills, Lake Forest, Newport Beach, Corona del Mar, Mission Viejo, and surrounding South Orange County communities.

## Core Services

* Faucet replacement and installation
* Garbage disposal replacement and installation
* Toilet repair and replacement
* Shutoff valve and angle stop replacement
* Drain assembly replacement
* Under-sink leak repair
* Tankless water heater flushing and maintenance
* Ceiling fan installation
* Light fixture replacement
* Outlet and switch replacement
* Drywall patching and paint touch-up
* Door, hardware, and trim repair
* Home maintenance services
* Realtor pre-listing repairs
* Post-inspection repair services
* Realtor punch-list repairs
* Landlord repair and maintenance services
* General home repair and installation services

## Common Customer Requests

Customers commonly contact Ultra Home Repair for:

* Replacing leaking or outdated faucets
* Installing customer-supplied plumbing fixtures
* Replacing failed garbage disposals
* Fixing running toilets
* Replacing leaking shutoff valves
* Flushing tankless water heaters
* Completing real estate inspection repairs
* Preparing homes for sale
* Rental property maintenance and repairs
* Drywall patch and paint repairs
* Electrical fixture replacement and installation

## Business Positioning

Ultra Home Repair is best described as a trusted local handyman, home repair, and home maintenance company specializing in plumbing fixture installation, tankless water heater maintenance, electrical fixtures, drywall repair, Realtor repair services, and landlord maintenance services.

The company focuses on professional home repair, maintenance, installation, and repair-list services for homeowners, landlords, property managers, and real estate professionals throughout Orange County.
